idea.title_concept: THE $47 BILLION COMPANY THAT ALMOST COLLAPSED OVERNIGHT
idea.story: WeWork's rise from coworking startup to one of the world's most valuable private companies — and the IPO filing that changed everything.
idea.hook: In January 2019, WeWork looked unstoppable. By fall, the IPO was dead.
idea.why_it_works: Famous company + absurd valuation + dramatic collapse.

avoid: Welcome back / In today's video / subscribe CTAs
creative_profile_snapshot.niche: Extraordinary true stories about companies, founders, money, power, ambition, fraud, competition, spectacular success and catastrophic failure.

audience.who: General English-speaking YouTube audience. No business expertise required.
audience.pain_points: Wants gripping true stories, not MBA lectures.

creative_profile_snapshot.tone: intelligent, cinematic, curious, entertaining, confident, clear
creative_profile_snapshot.hook_style: Start directly with the extraordinary situation — no channel intros.
creative_profile_snapshot.topics_to_avoid: Fabricated quotes or numbers; pure motivation content; dry textbook summaries; same company/story already covered in this session.
topics_to_focus: Products That Changed or Destroyed Companies
creative_profile_snapshot.title_style: Highly clickable without being misleading; specific stakes or numbers when true.
creative_profile_snapshot.thumbnail_style: Cinematic faces / moments / contrast; readable emotion; no spammy arrows.

channel.name: 100 Days — Business Documentaries
channel.content_pillars: Rise & Fall; Corporate Disasters; Fraud & Scams; Founder Stories; Business Wars; Billion-Dollar Mistakes; Hidden Empires / Monopolies; Strange Business History; Products That Changed or Destroyed Companies; Unexpected Success Stories

script.structure_preference: HOOK → CONTEXT → SETUP → ESCALATION → TURNING POINT → CONSEQUENCES → ENDING/TAKEAWAY
script.forbidden_phrases: Welcome back; In today's video; Make sure to subscribe; Like and comment
script.opening_style: Cold open on the extraordinary situation

visual.look: Premium cinematic documentary reenactment + archival when useful
visual.shot_preferences: Recurring character/location references; stills every few seconds
visual.b_roll_style: Offices, press, documents, city skylines, period-accurate details
visual.reference_moodboards: Google Flow masters for CHAR/LOC/OBJ before shot batch

editing.pacing_visual: Equal still duration locked to voice length
editing.notes_for_ai_director: Prefer continuity refs; avoid reinventing wardrobe/architecture

idea_generation.brief: Propose extraordinary true business stories for a daily English YouTube documentary channel. Storytelling before education. Prefer famous stakes, clear villains/heroes, and visualizable moments.
idea_generation.angles_to_favor: Rise & Fall, frauds, founder myths, corporate wars, monopoly stories, products that remade or ruined companies, unexpected successes.
idea_generation.angles_to_avoid: Generic hustle advice; listicles; fake drama; invented facts; repeating a company/story already produced in this channel; school-essay framing.

creative_profile_snapshot.notes_freeform: Publish one video per day for 100 days. Images via Google Flow manually. FrameFactory handles script, flow prompts, import, voice, render.
